title: German Pork Vindaloo
description: A twist on the classic Indian vindaloo, using German pork and infused oil.

ingredients.name: Infused oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral oil like canola or grapeseed

instructions: Heat the infused oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, red chili powder, cumin powder, and salt. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the pork is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Transfer to a bowl and serve.
